description: Show a design to the user in an interactive 3D viewer in the chat: they can press its button or flip its lever, watch it run tick by tick, move around, and click any part to read what it does. Give either design, or example (an id from list_examples). Simulate the design first. Do not use it to test a design: use simulate.

design.description: A machine: a list of blocks plus what it is for. See the server instructions for block types and rules.

blocks.description: Block objects: {type, x, y, z, ...fields, part}

parts.description: Part key -> {name, text}: what each part does, shown when the user clicks it

summary.description: One or two plain sentences: how it works and how to use it

test.description: Your test for this design (see TESTING in the instructions). Tick 0 is the machine once built; inputs at tick t happen after t game ticks, and expectations for tick t are checked right after them.

expect.description: What must be true: {at: [x,y,z], tick, is: {field: value}} or {at, from, to, is} (every tick from..to). Fields: type, shape (rails), on, lit, open, powered, extended, level, power, phase, locked, attached, inverted, facing, out (a comparator's output), count (items in a container). Or {shots: {min, max}, from, to, at?} for dispenser shots.

inputs.description: What a player does: {tick, do, at: [x,y,z]}. do: pull (lever), press (button), use (wooden door, wooden trapdoor or fence gate; optional look), stand (step onto a pressure plate or string), leave (step off), throw (a snowball at a target), turn_page (lectern), toggle (daylight detector), start (place a block against the observer marked "start": true; no at), place_cart (put a minecart on a rail)

ticks.description: How long to run (default: 60 ticks after the last input or expectation, at least 100)

time.description: Time of day at the start, 0-23999 (6000 = noon, the default); only daylight detectors use it

view.description: Optional starting camera for show, when the part to watch is small in a large machine: {target: [x,y,z] to look at, from: [x,y,z] the camera position}. Default: the whole machine.

example.description: Id of a built-in example to show instead of a design

name: show
title: Show a design in 3D
